title: How Becoming a Man of God Changes Who You Marry
caption:
The guy hunting for a wife reeks of it before he says a word. She can tell she's being chased to fill a hole, not loved as a person.

Spend the season you'd spend swiping asking God to make you a man worth marrying instead. "He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion." Philippians 1:6. That verse isn't about her. It's about you.

Chase God first and you stop asking a woman to carry your whole identity. Get the order right, and everything else stops being an emergency.

#faith #relationships #christianmen #manofgod #marriage
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
